CREATE TRIGGER num_of_meta_add  AFTER INSERT ON memories_setmap BEGIN  UPDATE memories_set SET num_of_meta = num_of_meta +  1  WHERE _id = new.set_id AND new.is_recycled = 0 ; END

CREATE TRIGGER year_month_day_add  AFTER INSERT ON local_media WHEN new.datetaken IS NOT NULL BEGIN  UPDATE local_media SET year = STRFTIME('%Y', datetaken / 1000,'unixepoch','localtime'),month = STRFTIME('%Y%m', datetaken / 1000,'unixepoch','localtime'),day = STRFTIME('%Y%m%d', datetaken / 1000,'unixepoch','localtime') WHERE _id = new._id; END

CREATE TRIGGER year_month_day_update  AFTER UPDATE OF datetaken ON local_media WHEN new.datetaken IS NOT NULL BEGIN  UPDATE local_media SET year = STRFTIME('%Y', datetaken / 1000,'unixepoch','localtime'),month = STRFTIME('%Y%m', datetaken / 1000,'unixepoch','localtime'),day = STRFTIME('%Y%m%d', datetaken / 1000,'unixepoch','localtime') WHERE _id = new._id; END
CREATE VIEW filter_local_view AS  SELECT  *  FROM local_media WHERE ((local_media.media_id > 0 ) AND (local_media.local_file_status >= 4))

CREATE VIEW memories_setmap_view AS SELECT media_id,memories_setmap._data as _data,datetaken,media_type,media_score,(CASE WHEN (is_single_face is null) THEN 0 END) AS is_single_face,set_id,is_big_cover,is_cover,in_video,tag_id FROM memories_setmap LEFT JOIN (SELECT _data,is_single_face FROM scan_face GROUP BY _data) AS scan_face ON memories_setmap._data = scan_face._data INNER JOIN local_media ON memories_setmap._data = local_media._data WHERE (memories_setmap.invalid IN (0,4)) AND memories_setmap.is_recycled = 0

CREATE VIEW person_pet_group_detail_view AS  SELECT person_pet_group._id AS _id,media_id,date_modified,datetaken,person_pet_group.media_type AS media_type,crop_rect,codec_type,merge_group_id,merge_group_name,score,is_chosen,is_default_cover,thumb_width,thumb_height,rect_left,rect_top,rect_right,rect_bottom,local_media._id AS local_id FROM person_pet_group INNER JOIN local_media ON local_media._data = person_pet_group._data WHERE (person_pet_group.invalid IN (0,4)) AND is_disband = 0  AND is_recycled = 0  AND media_id > 0

CREATE VIEW person_pet_group_list_view AS  SELECT merge_group_id,merge_group_name,person_group_ids,pet_group_ids,merge_group_create_type,merge_group_create_date,media_type, 0  AS num_all_faces, 0  AS num_image_faces, 0  AS num_video_faces FROM person_pet_group WHERE (_data IS NULL OR _data IS '') AND is_disband = 0  GROUP BY merge_group_id UNION ALL  SELECT merge_group_id,merge_group_name,person_group_ids,pet_group_ids,merge_group_create_type,merge_group_create_date,person_pet_group.media_type,count(DISTINCT (person_pet_group._data)) AS num_all_faces,count(DISTINCT ( CASE  WHEN (person_pet_group.media_type = 1 ) THEN media_id END)) AS num_image_faces,count(DISTINCT ( CASE  WHEN (person_pet_group.media_type = 3) THEN media_id END)) AS num_video_faces FROM person_pet_group INNER JOIN local_media ON local_media._data = person_pet_group._data WHERE person_pet_group.invalid = 0  AND person_pet_group.is_recycled = 0  AND is_disband = 0  AND media_id > 0  GROUP BY merge_group_id

CREATE VIEW person_pet_list_view AS  SELECT  *  FROM ( SELECT group_id,group_name,is_manual,manual_date,relation_type,custom_relation,pet.media_type AS media_type,'pet' AS role_type,count(DISTINCT (pet._data)) AS num_all_faces,count(DISTINCT ( CASE  WHEN (pet.media_type = 1 ) THEN media_id END)) AS num_image_faces,count(DISTINCT ( CASE  WHEN (pet.media_type= 3) THEN media_id END)) AS num_video_faces FROM pet INNER JOIN local_media ON local_media._data = pet._data WHERE pet.invalid = 0  AND pet.is_recycled = 0  AND is_hide = 0  AND group_id > 2 AND media_id > 0  GROUP BY group_id UNION ALL  SELECT group_id,group_name,is_manual,manual_date,relation_type,custom_relation,scan_face.media_type AS media_type,'person' AS role_type,count(DISTINCT (scan_face._data)) AS num_all_faces,count(DISTINCT ( CASE  WHEN (scan_face.media_type = 1 ) THEN media_id END)) AS num_image_faces,count(DISTINCT ( CASE  WHEN (scan_face.media_type= 3) THEN media_id END)) AS num_video_faces FROM scan_face INNER JOIN local_media ON local_media._data = scan_face._data WHERE scan_face.invalid = 0  AND scan_face.is_recycled = 0  AND is_hide = 0  AND no_face = 0  AND face_visible = 1  AND group_id > 2 AND media_id > 0  GROUP BY group_id)

CREATE VIEW pet_view AS  SELECT pet._id AS _id,media_id,date_modified,datetaken,pet.media_type AS media_type,crop_rect,codec_type,thumb_width,thumb_height,group_id,feature,final_score,rect_left,rect_top,rect_right,rect_bottom,is_chosen,is_default_cover,local_media._id AS local_id FROM pet INNER JOIN local_media ON local_media._data = pet._data WHERE (pet.invalid IN (0,4)) AND is_recycled = 0  AND is_hide = 0  AND group_id > 2 AND media_id > 0

CREATE VIEW scan_face_group_view AS SELECT group_visible, has_big_face, group_name, group_id, is_single_face, is_manual, manual_date, scan_face.media_type AS media_type, COUNT(DISTINCT(scan_face._data)) AS num_all_faces, COUNT(DISTINCT(CASE WHEN (scan_face.media_type = 1) THEN media_id END)) AS num_image_faces,  COUNT(DISTINCT(CASE WHEN (scan_face.media_type = 3) THEN media_id END)) AS num_video_faces,  SUM(CASE WHEN (is_small_face=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_big_faces,  AVG(age) AS avg_age,relation_type,custom_relation FROM scan_face INNER JOIN local_media ON local_media._data = scan_face._data WHERE scan_face.invalid = 0  AND scan_face.is_recycled = 0  AND is_hide = 0  AND no_face = 0  AND face_visible = 1  AND group_id > 2 AND media_id > 0  GROUP BY group_id

CREATE VIEW scan_face_view AS SELECT scan_face._id AS _id,media_id,date_modified,datetaken,scan_face.media_type AS media_type,crop_rect,codec_type,thumb_width,thumb_height,group_id,feature,score,yaw,pitch,roll,eye_dist,age,rect_left,rect_top,rect_right,rect_bottom,best_score,is_chosen,is_default_cover,is_small_face, face_cover_score,face_cover_expression,local_media._id AS local_id FROM scan_face INNER JOIN local_media ON local_media._data = scan_face._data WHERE (scan_face.invalid IN (0,4)) AND is_hide = 0  AND is_recycled = 0  AND no_face = 0  AND group_id > 2 AND media_id > 0

CREATE VIEW scan_travel_view AS  SELECT travel._id,local._data,local.media_id,travel.media_type,local.datetaken,local.date_modified,local.title,travel.order_type,travel.travel_destination,travel.travel_start_time,travel.travel_end_time,travel.travel_id,travel.score,travel.is_default_cover,travel.is_current_cover,local.is_favorite,travel_group.count,travel_group.image_count,travel_group.video_count FROM scan_travel travel INNER JOIN local_media local ON travel._data = local._data INNER JOIN ( SELECT travel.travel_id,count(DISTINCT travel._data) AS count,count(DISTINCT  CASE  WHEN travel.media_type = 1  THEN local.media_id END) AS image_count,count(DISTINCT  CASE  WHEN travel.media_type = 3  THEN local.media_id END) AS video_count FROM scan_travel travel INNER JOIN local_media local ON travel._data = local._data WHERE travel.invalid = 0  AND travel.is_trashed = 0  AND local.media_id > 0  GROUP BY travel.travel_id) travel_group ON travel.travel_id = travel_group.travel_id WHERE travel.invalid = 0  AND travel.is_trashed = 0  AND local.media_id > 0
